description: Fix ABGR color format for DrawList colors (needle shows dark blue instead of red) and add auto-scaling based on screen resolution
steps: Fix COLORS table in VehicleHUD.lua to use correct ABGR format for red/colored values
Fix default colors in lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua drawHealthBar function (yellow and red)
Fix default tick color in lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua drawTickMarks function (red zone)
Add auto-scaling based on screen resolution in VehicleHUD.lua main() function
acceptance_criteria: COLORS.needle uses ABGR format so it renders as bright red (not blue)
COLORS.tickRed uses ABGR format for red ticks
COLORS.engineOff uses ABGR format for red indicator
Health bar default colors use ABGR format for yellow and red
Tick marks default red zone uses ABGR format
Auto-scaling computes scale factor from screen width (base 1080px)
DPI is updated in main() after isSampAvailable()
Both files pass luajit -bl syntax validation
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/samp-android-lua-script && luajit -bl VehicleHUD.lua > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?  (should output 0)
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/samp-android-lua-script && luajit -bl lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?  (should output 0)
Grep for needle color 0xFF0000EE to verify ABGR red
Grep for autoScale to verify auto-scaling implementation
findings: All syntax checks pass (luajit -bl returns 0 for both files). Fixed ABGR colors: needle 0xFFEE1111->0xFF0000EE, tickRed 0xFFCC4444->0xFF4444CC, engineOff 0xFFFF3333->0xFF3333FF. Fixed health bar interpolation colors (yellow 0xFFCCCC44->0xFF44CCCC, red 0xFFCC4444->0xFF4444CC). Also fixed inline speed bar colors in Digital style and health colors in Minimal style. Auto-scaling uses getScreenResolution() with pcall, base 1080px width, clamped 0.6-2.5.
